text:
Type: abstract spotted area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, glam
Materials: synthetic pile, soft low texture
Colors: ivory, black
Shape: rectangular, all-over small irregular black brushmark spots, light low pile, medium size, plain edges
Feel: graphic, crisp, lively
Goes with: velvet sofas, brass accents, dark walls, herringbone floors; modern or glam rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Abstract Area Rug, 5' 11" x 3' 11", Ivory, Black
product.description: An abstract pattern against an ivory background will bring a modern global flair to your home. Offered in a variety of colors that will blend with most any room, the soft design is accented by light fringe. 5' 11" x 3' 11" Medium-high pile is soft and easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
